name: orsc-duck-v1
headline:
بطة الفضاء تصل إلى PS5
في Duck Side of the Moon
label: جديد
spoken: بطة الفضاء تصل إلى PS5 في Duck Side of the Moon، وموعد الإصدار 17 نوفمبر، مع تحديث Homegrown المجاني. تزرع فيه حديقتك بين الكواكب، وتزيّن سفينتك على ذوقك.

angle.hook: a cosy space game about a duck reaches PS5 with a free update in which you grow a garden among the planets
angle.why_now: the PS5 version and the free Homegrown update both arrive on Tuesday 17 Nov 2026 (Starbrew Games, press release of 2 Nov)
angle.what_it_means_here: PS5 players in the region can play it from Tuesday; PC and Switch owners get the update free the same day
angle.payoff: planting your own crops in space and restyling your ship room by room

story_type_items.RELEASE (dated launch): PS5 date 17 Nov 2026 from the Starbrew Games press release; platforms already out (PC via Steam and Epic Games Store, Nintendo Switch) in the caption; PS5 price not announced, so not on screen
story_type_items.UPDATE: what changes: gardening, ship customisation, new area, characters and story; free for all players, same day; unlocks about halfway through (caption)
story_type_items.TRAILER: the studio's own Homegrown Update and PS5 announcement trailer on Steam, credited «المصدر: ستاربرو جيمز (Starbrew Games)» on every shot from frame 0

sensitive: none: a cosy game with no combat or death (press release); no weapons, no violence anywhere in the trailer
decision_log: sound: one stretch of the trailer's own sound from 3.9 s, music_only true (faster-whisper small on the session copy heard no speech; music runs to 26.8 s, silence after), so the music stem alone runs under the Reel; the body is about 14 s, so the stretch ends near 18 s, well before the music stops

0-3.95 headline beat: the duck flapping on the grass (3.9, 0.8, fo 0.36; crossfade at 4.75 avoided), the duck floating by the beanstalk in space (5.0, 0.75, fo 0.36; at 0.42 the duck was cut at the left edge), the duck riding an asteroid (14.45, 1.3), the floating island with the duck (10.3, 1.1, fo 0.66; the planet-circle transition before 10.2 avoided); the telescope island was dropped (the telescope cut at both 9:16 edges, the duck outside the window)

card after the hook: fact card «موعد الإصدار» · «17 نوفمبر» · «مع تحديث Homegrown المجاني» over the telescope island footage, dimmed (ground_footage 5.8): the date and the free update, which the footage cannot show
breathing shot after the card: the flowering vine slope by the waterfall (16.05, 1.35, fo 0.5)

«تزرع فيه حديقتك بين الكواكب» over the crops sprouting and flowering (0.0, 1.45; the HOMEGROWN UPDATE title card from 1.5 avoided) and the duck harvesting in the garden patch (13.05, 1.35; the dialogue box before 13.0 avoided)
«وتزيّن سفينتك على ذوقك» over the ship room changing its walls and floors (20.35, 2.5; the crafting-station UI before 20.3 and the end slate at 23.0 avoided); the last 2 s are this picture
left out: title cards 1.5-2.9 and 23.0 on, dialogue boxes 7.3-8.4, 11.5-12.9, 18.0-19.0, crafting UI 19.0-20.3
crops judged on 4 fps sheets of the session copy (HLS master, 1920x1080)

v1 text fix (server font check 05:48Z: «لعبة Duck Side of the Moon / تصدر على PS5 الثلاثاء» needs more than 2 lines at 72 px): headline «بطة الفضاء تصل إلى PS5 / في Duck Side of the Moon» (the hook first, the game named on the cover, تصل إلى + the platform per the glossary); the date moved to the card
card note shortened to «مع تحديث Homegrown المجاني» (server font check 05:51Z: wider than the plate); «لكل المنصات» stays in the caption and the X text
